column2: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR AN INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK FOR THE
REGULATION OF SECURED TRANSACTIONS IN MOVABLE PROPERTY BY
THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE SECURED TRANSACTIONS REGISTRATION
AUTHORITY; TO SET OUT THE POWERS AND DUTIES OF SUCH AUTHORITY;
TO PROVIDE FOR THE DETERMINING OF PRIORITIES AMONGST CREDITORS
HAVING COMPETING SECURITY RIGHTS IN THE MOVABLE PROPERTY OF
THEIR DEBTORS; TO SET OUT THE RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF PARTIES TO
SECURITY AGREEMENTS; TO PROVIDE FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT AND
MAINTENANCE OF A REGISTRY OF SECURITY RIGHTS IN MOVABLE
PROPERTY AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL

Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-
